features:
小米8是小米数字系列第七代、也是小米成立8周年的特别纪念机型，直接跳过「小米7」命名。整机采用「四曲面玻璃 + 7系铝中框」的轻薄圆润结构，机身尺寸相当于5.5英寸传统手机，握持感扎实却仅175g。正面为6.21英寸三星AMOLED刘海异形屏，屏占比约86.7%，支持DCI-P3广色域、60000:1对比度与AOD熄屏显示，机械与材料的克制感极强，是装裱展示的天然好题材。

影像为最大卖点：后置AI变焦双摄，主摄采用索尼IMX363（1/2.55英寸、1.4μm大像素、f/1.8、四轴光学防抖、全像素双核对焦），长焦为三星S5K3M3（f/2.4、2倍光学变焦），DxOMark拍照105分、视频88分，超越同期iPhone X的101分。前置2000万像素三星S5K3T1，支持像素四合一与「AI微整形」美颜。刘海区集成独立红外镜头+红外补光灯，实现全黑环境可用的红外人脸识别。

内部采用三段式布局，主板带散热铜片、屏蔽罩与NFC线圈盖板，电池为飞毛腿代工的BM3E锂聚合物电芯（3400mAh typ），标配18W QC3.0充电头但支持QC4+。整机拆解难度低、胶粘可复原，零件摆列规整、色彩克制（黑/白/金/蓝），非常契合「零件功能图鉴」式的平面化装裱——把主板、双摄模组、线性马达、电池标签等单独裱框，能直观呈现2018年国产旗舰的工业美学。

parts.name: 玻璃后盖
parts.note: 四曲面玻璃，胶粘固定无螺丝；后盖开「天窗」露出主摄保护盖。拆解需热风枪加热+塑料片分离，胶可保持原状复原——装裱摆件时建议保留带天窗的原盖以呈现结构巧思。

parts.name: 7系铝中框
parts.note: 「水滴弧形」收腰设计，四曲面玻璃与中框衔接。为减重未用小米6的不锈钢，整机仅175g——装裱时中框是承载所有零件的结构骨架，最适合做主视觉框。

parts.name: 主板
parts.note: 三段式顶部主板，散热铜片为视觉主色；NFC芯片整合在主板保护盖板上。拆机报告称主摄需暴力抠下胶固保护盖才能取下——非必要不拆，以免破坏防护。

parts.name: 副板
parts.note: 底部副板集成 Type-C（充电/数据/音频三合一）接口，背面双面胶固定到机身；拧3颗小十字螺丝与主板相连。Type-C居中对称排布，装裱可单独展示接口精度。

parts.name: 主摄像头模组
parts.note: 索尼IMX363，f/1.8、四轴OIS、Dual PD。与主板/玻璃保护罩/主板盖「夹心」嵌合。拆机报告注明副摄须暴力破坏才能拆，主摄可复原——装裱优先取主摄模组。

parts.name: 前置摄像头
parts.note: 三星S5K3T1，2000万、f/2.0，散热铜片强力固定。刘海内最易辨别的自拍元件，拆解相对简单。装裱可配红外相机同框呈现「刘海全家福」。

parts.name: 线性振动马达
parts.note: 长条线性马达（非转子），拆机报告明确点名。横向线性马达带来更清脆的「哒哒」手感，是2018旗舰质感的隐藏亮点，单独裱框很有机械美感。

parts.name: BM3E 锂电池
parts.note: 飞毛腿代工，3400mAh typ / 3300mAh min，3.85V，13.0Wh，限充4.40V。标签含SN/日期(2018.05)。⚠ 锂电禁止拆解/刺破/挤压/火烧，装裱仅展示标签面，切勿破坏电芯。

parts.name: 后置指纹识别
parts.note: 标准版为后置电容指纹（透明探索版/屏幕指纹版才是屏下）。排线连主板、接口无金属片固定，撬开即可。标准版用户以此区分版本，装裱标注需注明「标准版」。

parts.name: 红外相机
parts.note: 刘海内独立红外镜头，配合红外补光实现全黑人脸解锁，4096特征点。拆机报告称其为刘海元件中最易拆下者（撬排线即可，不破坏结构）。

components.name: 玻璃后盖
components.desc: 小米8 后盖采用四曲面玻璃，通过胶黏工艺与中框固定，整机无一颗外露螺丝。后盖中央偏上位置开有「天窗」结构，用于露出主摄像头保护盖。拆解时以热风枪加热可令胶层软化，实现后盖完整分离且胶性可复原，便于维修与二次装裱。
components.descEn: The Mi 8 back cover is four-sided curved glass, bonded to the frame with adhesive and free of exposed screws. A "skylight" cutout near the upper center exposes the main-camera cover. Heating softens the glue for clean separation with reusable adhesion, aiding repair and reframing.
components.note: 装裱价值：带天窗的原盖最能体现结构巧思，建议保留原盖摆件；⚠ 拆解须热风枪加热，硬撬易碎。
components.noteEn: Framing: keep original cover with cutout; ⚠ use heat gun, never pry cold.

components.name: 7系铝合金中框
components.desc: 中框采用 7 系铝合金，经「水滴弧形」收腰处理，与四曲面玻璃精密衔接。为将整机重量控制在 175g，小米放弃此前小米6 所用的不锈钢方案，改用更轻的铝合金——这是数字系列首次以轻量化替代不锈钢，也是握持手感轻薄的关键。
components.descEn: The frame is 7-series aluminum with a "water-drop" waist taper, precisely joining the four curved glass panels. To keep weight at 175g, Xiaomi dropped the Mi 6's stainless steel for lighter alloy—the first Mi flagship to prioritize weight, and the reason for its slim grip.
components.note: 装裱价值：中框是承载全部零件的结构骨架，最适合单独做主视觉框；历史意义：标志小米数字系列首次以轻量化替代不锈钢。
components.noteEn: Framing: frame is the structural backbone, ideal hero piece; historical: first Mi flagship to drop stainless for weight.

components.name: 刘海异形屏
components.desc: 正面为带「下巴」的刘海异形全面屏，刘海区域较同期机型更宽，内部密集集成红外相机、红外补光灯、听筒及距离/环境光传感器。这一布局在视觉上牺牲了部分屏占比，却为「全黑环境人脸解锁」提供了硬件基础。
components.descEn: The front is a notched all-screen with a chin; the notch runs wider than peers, densely packing an IR camera, IR illuminator, earpiece and proximity/ambient sensors. The wider notch trades some screen area for hardware-enabled face unlock in darkness.
components.note: 装裱提示：刘海区元件密集，拆解展示时建议整屏+刘海元件同框，方能呈现「为什么刘海这么大」。
components.noteEn: Framing: display the notch array together to show why the notch is so wide.

components.name: 双 Nano-SIM 卡槽
components.desc: 机身左侧设置双 Nano-SIM 卡槽，支持双卡双待，任一卡槽均可设为主卡，两张卡均支持 4G 驻网与 VoLTE 高清语音。卡槽本体带「此面朝屏（FACE TO SCREEN）」丝印，注塑与密封胶圈工艺精细。
components.descEn: A left-side dual Nano-SIM tray supports dual standby; either slot can be primary, both with 4G and VoLTE. The tray is laser-marked "FACE TO SCREEN" and shows fine injection-molded and gasket detailing.
components.note: 装裱提示：卡槽带「此面朝屏 FACE TO SCREEN」丝印，可单独裱框展示精密注塑与密封胶圈。
components.noteEn: Framing: tray is laser-marked 'FACE TO SCREEN', a neat detail piece.

components.name: 侧边按键
components.desc: 右侧排布电源键与音量键，与中框同色阳极氧化处理，按键行程清脆。作为机身交互的主要物理入口，其配色与质感与中框高度统一，是整机工业语言的一致性体现。
components.descEn: Power and volume keys sit on the right, anodized to match the frame with a crisp click. As the main physical controls, their color and finish echo the frame—consistent with the device's industrial language.
components.note: 装裱提示：按键体积小但识别度高，可归入「结构件」微框组合。
components.noteEn: Framing: small but recognizable, group as micro-structure set.

components.name: 四曲面收腰设计
components.desc: 背部四曲面玻璃配合机身「水滴弧形」收腰，曲率经过贴合手心的设计，令单手握持圆润轻薄。这一形态语言是小米8 外观上最具辨识度的特征，也是其区别于同期直板机型的核心设计点。
components.descEn: The back's four curved panels meet a cinched "water-drop" waist tuned to the palm, giving a rounded, slim one-handed grip. This form language is Mi 8's most recognizable identity and its key design departure from flat rivals.
components.note: 装裱价值：曲面光影在平裱时易显单调，建议侧光拍摄以突出弧面高光。
components.noteEn: Framing: use side lighting to reveal curvature highlights.

components.name: AMOLED 显示面板
components.desc: 小米8 正面搭载 6.21 英寸三星 AMOLED 异形全面屏，18.7:9 屏幕比例，分辨率 2248×1080（FHD+ 级别）。相比传统 LCD，AMOLED 采用自发光像素阵列，黑色区域可完全关闭像素点，实现「纯黑」显示效果；同时支持 DCI-P3 广色域与 HDR 高动态范围，色彩覆盖范围更广、明暗过渡更自然。峰值亮度可达 600nit（高亮模式），户外可视性良好。此外还支持 AOD（Always-On Display）息屏显示功能，锁屏状态下可持续展示时间与通知信息。需注意 OLED 有机发光材料存在烧屏风险，长期显示静态画面可能留下残影，展示样机建议开启屏保或循环内容。
components.descEn: The Mi 8 front uses a 6.21" Samsung AMOLED notched panel at 18.7:9, 2248×1080 (FHD+). Unlike LCD, AMOLED pixels self-illuminate, so black areas can switch off entirely for true blacks; it also supports DCI-P3 wide gamut and HDR for broader color and smoother tonal transitions. Peak brightness reaches 600nit in high-brightness mode for good outdoor visibility. AOD (Always-On Display) keeps time and notifications visible on the locked screen. Note that OLED organic material risks burn-in under static content—demo units should use a screensaver or looped content.
components.note: 装裱价值：点亮后纯黑底+鲜艳色是海报级素材；⚠ OLED有烧屏风险，展示样机建议长期熄屏或循环内容。
components.noteEn: Framing: lit OLED is poster-grade; ⚠ risk of burn-in, keep demo screen off.

components.name: 触控感应层
components.desc: 显示面板上方复合电容触控层，支持多点触控与手套模式，与显示层以 in-cell 工艺贴合为一体化结构。刘海区域的触控走线需避让传感器开孔，工艺复杂度高于普通全面屏。该层与面板不可分离，展示时以整屏为主。
components.descEn: A capacitive touch layer sits above the panel, enabling multi-touch and glove mode, bonded to the display via in-cell process as one unit. Touch routing around the notch sensors is more complex than on ordinary screens. The layer is non-removable; show the whole panel.
components.note: 装裱提示：触控层不可单独取下，展示以整屏为主，勿尝试分离以免碎屏。
components.noteEn: Framing: touch layer is non-removable; show whole panel only.

components.name: 刘海传感器区
components.desc: 刘海内部集成红外相机、红外补光灯、听筒、距离传感器与环境光传感器，构成小米8「全黑人脸解锁」的硬件基础。元件密集排布是刘海较宽的直接原因，将整组元件同框展示，最能直观解释这一结构设计的取舍。
components.descEn: The notch integrates an IR camera, IR illuminator, earpiece, proximity and ambient sensors—the hardware basis for face unlock in darkness. Their dense packing explains the wide notch; showing the group together clarifies the design trade-off.
components.note: 装裱价值：刘海元件摆放在一起最能讲清「刘海为何这么大」，建议微距拍摄成组。
components.noteEn: Framing: group notch parts to explain the wide notch.

components.name: 主摄像头(广角)
components.desc: 主摄采用索尼 IMX363 传感器，1/2.55 英寸感光面积、1200 万像素、单像素 1.4μm，配备 f/1.8 光圈、四轴光学防抖与全像素双核（Dual PD）对焦。凭借大底与大像素的组合，小米8 在 DxOMark 拍照单项取得 105 分，是 2018 年国产旗舰影像标杆。模组金属环配蓝圈标识，辨识度极高。
components.descEn: The main camera uses a Sony IMX363 sensor—1/2.55", 12MP, 1.4μm pixels, f/1.8, with 4-axis OIS and Dual PD AF. The large sensor and pixel size helped Mi 8 score 105 on DxOMark photo, a 2018 domestic flagship benchmark. The blue-ringed metal barrel is highly recognizable.
components.note: 装裱价值：主摄模组金属环+蓝圈标识极具辨识度，最适合单独裱框；拆解警告：保护盖为胶固，抠下不可复原，非必要不拆。
components.noteEn: Framing: blue-ringed module is iconic; ⚠ cover is glued, do not pry unless needed.

components.name: 长焦副摄
components.desc: 副摄为三星 S5K3M3，1200 万像素、f/2.4 光圈，提供 2 倍光学变焦与人像背景虚化，与主摄共同组成 AI 变焦双摄系统。拆机资料显示其以铜片强力固定于屏蔽罩之上，取下需破坏结构，故展示以原状为宜。
components.descEn: The tele camera is a Samsung S5K3M3, 12MP, f/2.4, giving 2× optical zoom and portrait bokeh alongside the main cam in an AI zoom dual-camera system. Teardown shows it is copper-fixed to the shield can and removed only destructively—display in original state.
components.note: 拆解警告：拆机报告明确副摄须暴力破坏铜片固定才能取下，会损伤散热结构——装裱仅展示，勿拆。
components.noteEn: ⚠ Teardown notes tele cam needs destructive removal, damaging thermal structure; display only.

components.name: 前置摄像头
components.desc: 前置为三星 S5K3T1，2000 万像素、f/2.0，单像素 0.9μm（四合一等效 1.8μm），支持 AI 美颜与单摄虚化，由散热铜片强力固定。作为刘海内最易辨识的自拍元件，其拆解相对简单，适合与红外相机同框呈现「刘海全家福」。
components.descEn: The front camera is a Samsung S5K3T1, 20MP, f/2.0, 0.9μm (1.8μm in 4-in-1), with AI beautify and single-cam bokeh, copper-shield fixed. As the most recognizable selfie part in the notch, it is relatively easy to remove and pairs well with the IR cam as a "notch family" set.
components.note: 装裱价值：可与红外相机同框成「刘海全家福」；拆解相对简单（撬排线即可）。
components.noteEn: Framing: pair with IR cam as 'notch family'; relatively easy to remove.

components.name: 红外相机
components.desc: 刘海内独立红外镜头，与红外补光灯协同构建 4096 维人脸特征模型，即便在照片或视频假体攻击下亦不可破解，实现全黑环境可用的人脸解锁。其体积在刘海元件中最小，拆卸以撬开排线即可、不伤结构，适合做微距特写。
components.descEn: A dedicated IR lens in the notch works with the IR illuminator to build a 4096-dimension face model, spoof-proof even against photo/video and usable in total darkness. Smallest of the notch parts and removable via flex cable without damage—ideal for macro detail.
components.note: 装裱价值：刘海元件中体积最小、最易拆（撬排线不伤结构），适合做微距特写框。
components.noteEn: Framing: smallest notch part, easiest removal, great for macro detail.

components.name: 红外补光灯
components.desc: 隐藏于刘海内的红外补光元件，在全黑环境主动投射人眼不可见的红外光，供红外相机采集人脸特征，是红外人脸解锁链路中不可或缺的补光部件。展示时可配文字说明其「不可见光」工作原理。
components.descEn: A hidden IR LED in the notch projects invisible infrared light in darkness for the IR camera to capture face features—an essential part of the face-unlock chain. Caption the "invisible light" principle when displaying.
components.note: 装裱提示：肉眼不可见其发光，展示时可配文字说明「不可见光」机理。
components.noteEn: Framing: invisible to eye; caption the 'invisible light' principle.

components.name: 骁龙 845 处理器
components.desc: 小米8 搭载高通 2018 年旗舰平台骁龙 845，采用 Kryo 385 CPU（4×A75@2.8GHz + 4×A75@1.8GHz）、10nm LPP 制程，集成 X20 LTE 调制解调器，安兔兔跑分约 30 万，是当年安卓性能第一梯队。芯片表面镭雕型号，是「芯片美学」的经典题材。
components.descEn: The Mi 8 runs the 2018 flagship Snapdragon 845—Kryo 385 CPU (4×A75@2.8G + 4×A75@1.8G), 10nm LPP, X20 LTE modem, ~300k AnTuTu, top-tier Android performance. Its laser-etched markings are a classic "chip aesthetic" subject.
components.note: 装裱价值：SoC表面镭雕型号是「芯片美学」经典题材；⚠ 静电敏感，裸片展示需防静电袋/干燥环境。
components.noteEn: Framing: laser-etched model is iconic; ⚠ ESD-sensitive, keep in antistatic.

components.name: Adreno 630 GPU
components.desc: 图形处理由集成于骁龙 845 的 Adreno 630 承担，最高频率 710MHz，支持 OpenGL ES 3.2、Vulkan 与 OpenCL，属 2018 年安卓阵营顶级图形性能。该单元与 SoC 同封装，不单独存在。
components.descEn: Graphics are handled by the Adreno 630 inside the SD845, up to 710MHz, with OpenGL ES 3.2, Vulkan and OpenCL—top 2018 Android graphics. It shares the SoC package and does not exist separately.
components.note: 装裱提示：与SoC同封装，不单独存在，标注时归并于骁龙845一起说明。
components.noteEn: Framing: same package as SoC, document together.

components.name: LPDDR4x 运行内存
components.desc: 提供 6GB 或 8GB LPDDR4x 双通道内存，低功耗高速，实际可用容量因系统占用低于标称值。内存颗粒以 BGA 工艺焊接于主板，无法单独取出，展示以主板整体为主。
components.descEn: 6/8GB LPDDR4x dual-channel RAM offers low-power speed, though usable capacity is below label due to OS overhead. The BGA-soldered chips cannot be removed—show the mainboard as a whole.
components.note: 装裱价值：内存颗粒通常焊接于主板，无法单独取出，展示以主板整体为主。
components.noteEn: Framing: RAM is BGA-soldered, show mainboard as whole.

components.name: UFS 2.1 闪存
components.desc: 内置 64/128/256GB UFS 2.1 高速闪存，不支持容量扩展，随机读写性能优于同期 eMMC 机型。闪存颗粒同样焊接于主板，装裱时以「主板 + 芯片丝印」整体呈现即可。
components.descEn: 64/128/256GB UFS 2.1 storage, non-expandable, outperforms eMMC peers in random I/O. BGA-soldered like RAM—present the mainboard with silkscreen as a unit.
components.note: 装裱提示：闪存颗粒同样焊接，装裱时以「主板+芯片丝印」整体呈现即可。
components.noteEn: Framing: BGA-soldered; present mainboard with silkscreen.

components.name: BM3E 锂聚合物电池
components.desc: 电池由飞毛腿（SCUD）代工，型号 BM3E，容量 3400mAh（典型值）/ 3300mAh（最小值），标称电压 3.85V、限充 4.40V、能量 13.0Wh，标签载有 SN 与 2018.05 生产日期。锂聚合物电芯以铝塑膜封装，严禁穿刺、挤压、火烧或浸水；装裱仅展示标签面，且不可破坏封装。2020 年官方曾推出 49 元低价换电池服务。
components.descEn: The battery is SCUD-made, model BM3E, 3400mAh typ / 3300mAh min, 3.85V nom / 4.40V limit, 13.0Wh, with SN and a 2018.05 date on the label. The Li-Po cell uses an aluminum-pouch wrap—never puncture, crush, burn or immerse; show label side only. In 2020 Xiaomi offered a low-cost ¥49 battery swap.
components.note: ⚠ 锂电安全：严禁拆解/刺破/挤压/火烧/浸水；装裱仅展示标签面，且不可破坏铝塑膜。2020年官方曾推49元换电池。
components.noteEn: ⚠ Li-Po safety: no disassembly/puncture/crush/fire/immerse; show label side only, never breach pouch. In 2020 Xiaomi offered a low-cost ¥49 battery swap.

components.name: USB Type-C 接口
components.desc: 底部居中布置 USB Type-C 接口，集充电、数据与音频输出三合一，对称式排布，集成于副板，支持 QC4+ 快充协议（标配 18W QC3.0 充电头）。接口金属触点规整，是极简工业风的素材；需注意该机取消 3.5mm 耳机孔，音频改由 Type-C 承载。
components.descEn: A centered bottom Type-C combines charging, data and audio, symmetrically laid out on the sub-board, with QC4+ support (18W QC3.0 charger boxed). Its neat metal contacts suit minimalist framing; note the 3.5mm jack was dropped, audio routed through Type-C.
components.note: 装裱价值：接口居中对称，单独展示金属触点为极简工业风素材；⚠ 无3.5mm耳机孔，音频走Type-C。
components.noteEn: Framing: centered port with metal contacts is minimalist; ⚠ no 3.5mm jack.

components.name: 电源管理/充电 IC
components.desc: 主板与副板上的电源管理芯片组负责骁龙 845 的供电与 QC4+ 快充协议握手，包含多处 PMIC 与电荷泵。具体芯片型号需以实物丝印核对，本资料未逐一确认，标注为「未验证」，展示以主板整体为主。
components.descEn: The PMIC cluster on main/sub-board powers the SD845 and negotiates QC4+ charging, with multiple PMICs and charge pumps. Exact models need physical verification and are marked "unverified" here; show the mainboard as a whole.
components.note: 装裱提示：具体PMIC型号需实物丝印核对，本资料未逐一确认，标「未验证」；展示以主板整体为主。
components.noteEn: Framing: exact PMIC models unverified; show mainboard as whole, mark uncertain.

components.name: 主板
components.desc: 主板采用三段式布局，顶部主板表面覆盖大面积散热铜片，构成整机视觉主色调，其上密布骁龙 845、内存、闪存、射频与电源管理芯片，集成度极高。作为拆解图鉴的绝对主角，平裱加微距最能呈现 2018 年旗舰的精密排布；需注意主摄保护盖以胶固，非必要不拆。
components.descEn: The mainboard uses a three-section layout; its top is covered by a large copper heatsink that sets the device's visual tone, densely packing the SD845, RAM, ROM, RF and PMIC—highly integrated. As the hero of any teardown frame, flat-plus-macro best shows 2018 flagship density; note the main-cam cover is glued, avoid removing unless needed.
components.note: 装裱价值：主板是「零件图鉴」绝对主角，平裱+微距最能呈现2018旗舰的精密排布；⚠ 主摄需暴力抠胶才能拆，非必要不拆。
components.noteEn: Framing: mainboard is the hero of any teardown frame; ⚠ main cam glued, avoid removing.

components.name: 副板
components.desc: 底部副板集成 Type-C、麦克风及部分射频与天线走线，背面以双面胶固定机身，并以 3 颗小十字螺丝与主板相连。副板与 Type-C 可单独成框，展现底部 I/O 布局的对称美学。
components.descEn: The bottom sub-board integrates Type-C, mic and some RF/antenna routing, double-taped to the chassis and linked to the mainboard by 3 small screws. Sub-board plus Type-C make a clean I/O detail frame.
components.note: 装裱提示：副板+Type-C可单独成框，展现底部I/O布局的对称美学。
components.noteEn: Framing: sub-board + Type-C makes a clean I/O detail frame.

components.name: NFC 芯片
components.desc: NFC 芯片整合于主板保护盖板（拆机报告指黑色带纹路处），支持多功能 NFC，可模拟约 167 城公交卡与门禁卡。具体芯片型号（如 NXP 系列）需实物丝印核对，本资料未确认，标注「未验证」。
components.descEn: The NFC IC sits on the mainboard cover plate (textured black area per teardown), enabling multi-function NFC for ~167 city transit and access cards. Exact model (e.g. NXP) needs verification and is marked "unverified"
components.note: 装裱提示：具体NFC芯片型号（如NXP系列）需实物丝印核对，本资料未确认，标「未验证」。
components.noteEn: Framing: exact NFC IC model unverified; mark uncertain.

components.name: 双频 GPS 模块
components.desc: 小米8 全球首发 L1+L5 双频 GPS，同时支持 Galileo E1+E5a、QZSS L1+L5、GLONASS L1 与北斗 B1，在城市峡谷等复杂环境下定位精度显著优于单频方案。这是该机当年核心卖点之一，也是安卓阵营双频定位的开端。
components.descEn: The Mi 8 debuted L1+L5 dual-frequency GPS worldwide, also supporting Galileo E1+E5a, QZSS L1+L5, GLONASS L1 and BeiDou B1, with markedly better urban-canyon accuracy than single-frequency. A key 2018 selling point and the start of dual-GPS on Android.
components.note: 历史意义：小米8是全球首款双频GPS手机，定位能力是当年核心卖点之一。
components.noteEn: Historical: world's first dual-frequency GPS phone.

components.name: WiFi/蓝牙模块
components.desc: 无线连接集成于骁龙 845 平台，支持 802.11a/b/g/n/ac 双频、2×2 MIMO 与 MU-MIMO，以及蓝牙 5.0（AAC / aptX / aptX-HD）。该模块与 SoC 同封装，不单独存在，归并于主板说明。
components.descEn: Wireless is part of the SD845: 802.11ac dual-band 2×2 MIMO, MU-MIMO, and BT5.0 with AAC/aptX/aptX-HD. Integrated in the SoC, it is documented with the mainboard.
components.note: 装裱提示：模块为SoC集成，不单独存在，归并于骁龙845与主板说明。
components.noteEn: Framing: integrated in SoC; document with mainboard.

components.name: 红外人脸识别单元
components.desc: 由刘海内红外相机、红外补光灯与算法共同构成，建立 4096 维人脸特征模型，即便全黑环境或面对照片/视频假体亦不可破解。作为安卓阵营早期红外结构光路线的代表，其硬件构成可借「刘海全家福」图说清晰呈现。
components.descEn: Built from the notch's IR camera, IR illuminator and algorithm, it builds a 4096-d face model, spoof-proof even in darkness or against photo/video. An early Android IR-face approach; its hardware is best explained via a "notch family" caption.
components.note: 装裱价值：可配「刘海全家福」图说讲清Face ID式解锁的硬件构成；历史意义：安卓阵营早期红外结构光路线代表。
components.noteEn: Framing: pair with notch family; historical: early Android IR-face approach.

components.name: 后置指纹识别
components.desc: 标准版采用后置电容式指纹（透明探索版与屏幕指纹版为屏下方案），经排线连接主板，接口无金属片固定，撬开即可取下。需注明「标准版 = 后置指纹」，与压感屏下指纹的探索版区分，装裱可按版本分别标注。
components.descEn: The standard edition uses a rear capacitive FPS (Explorer / screen-fingerprint editions differ, under-display), flex-linked to the mainboard. Label "standard = rear FPS" to distinguish from the pressure-sensitive under-display Explorer edition; frame by variant.
components.note: 易混淆点：务必注明「标准版=后置指纹」；透明探索版才是压感屏下指纹。装裱可按版本分别标注。
components.noteEn: Clarify: standard = rear FPS; Explorer edition = under-display. Label by variant.

components.name: 六轴陀螺仪+加速度计
components.desc: 通常以单封装六轴 IMU（陀螺仪 + 加速度计）实现，负责姿态感知、旋转检测、计步与游戏操控，是传感器阵列的核心。具体型号（如 ICM-20690 类）需实物丝印核对，本资料标注「未验证」，归并于传感器微框组合。
components.descEn: Usually a single-package 6-axis IMU (gyro + accel) for orientation, rotation, step-count and gaming—core to the sensor array. Exact model (e.g. ICM-20690-class) needs verification, marked "unverified", grouped as a sensor micro-set.
components.note: 装裱提示：具体型号(如ICM-20690类)需实物丝印核对，本资料标「未验证」；归并于传感器微框组合。
components.noteEn: Framing: exact model unverified; group as sensor micro-set.

components.name: 气压计
components.desc: 测量环境气压，辅助 GPS 进行海拔估算与室内楼层定位，从而提升双频 GPS 的导航精度。该传感器在小米数字系列中较为少见，可配合双频 GPS 讲述「精准导航」的设计故事。
components.descEn: Measures air pressure to aid GPS altitude and floor-level indoor positioning, improving dual-GPS navigation accuracy. Rare in the Mi numbered series, it pairs with dual-GPS for a "precise navigation" story.
components.note: 装裱价值：小米数字系列少见的传感器，可配双频GPS讲「精准导航」故事。
components.noteEn: Framing: rare sensor, pairs with dual-GPS navigation story.

components.name: 霍尔传感器
components.desc: 检测磁场变化，用于智能皮套翻盖亮灭屏等场景，通常贴装于中框附近。体积微小，归入传感器组合框展示即可。
components.descEn: Detects magnetic field for flip-cover wake/sleep, near the frame. Tiny—include in the sensor set.
components.note: 装裱提示：体积微小，归入传感器组合框展示即可。
components.noteEn: Framing: tiny, include in sensor set.

components.name: 环境光传感器
components.desc: 位于刘海内，检测环境亮度以自动调节屏幕，并联动「阳光屏 / 护眼模式」，与距离传感器协同工作。建议与距离传感器同框展示。
components.descEn: In the notch, it auto-adjusts brightness and drives sunlight/eye-care modes, working with the proximity sensor. Show with proximity.
components.note: 装裱提示：与距离传感器同居刘海，建议同框展示。
components.noteEn: Framing: co-located with proximity in notch; show together.

components.name: 距离传感器
components.desc: 刘海内红外距离传感，通话时检测贴近以熄屏防误触，常与环境光传感器同封装。与刘海元件一同呈现，可解释「贴耳熄屏」的工作机理。
components.descEn: Notch IR proximity sensor switches the screen off when held to the ear, often co-packaged with ALS. Show with notch parts to explain call behavior.
components.note: 装裱提示：与刘海元件一同呈现，解释「贴耳熄屏」机理。
components.noteEn: Framing: show with notch parts to explain call behavior.

components.name: 电子罗盘
components.desc: 三轴磁力计，提供方向感知，配合 GPS 与陀螺仪实现地图导航与 AR 方向指示。具体型号需实物核对，标注「未验证」，归并于传感器组合。
components.descEn: A 3-axis magnetometer for heading, aiding GPS/gyro navigation and AR. Model unverified, grouped in the sensor set.
components.note: 装裱提示：型号需实物核对，标「未验证」；归并传感器组合。
components.noteEn: Framing: model unverified; group in sensor set.

components.name: 听筒
components.desc: 刘海内听筒兼顾通话出声，并与底部扬声器组成伪双声道外放，金属触点为信号接口。其金属触点细节可作微距特写，配合红外补光同框讲述「刘海元件」的设计。
components.descEn: The notch earpiece handles calls and pairs with the bottom speaker for pseudo-stereo, with metal contact points. Macro the contacts and pair with the IR story.
components.note: 装裱价值：听筒金属触点细节可微距特写，配红外补光同框讲「刘海元件」。
components.noteEn: Framing: macro the metal contacts; pair with notch story.

components.name: 扬声器
components.desc: 底部扬声器固定于副板保护盖，居中对称排布，与听筒协同提供外放声场。网罩与对称布局是极简风素材，可单独成框。
components.descEn: The bottom speaker is fixed to the sub-board cover, symmetric, pairing with the earpiece for output. Its grille and symmetry suit minimalist standalone framing.
components.note: 装裱提示：扬声器网罩+对称布局是极简风素材，可单独成框。
components.noteEn: Framing: symmetric grille is minimalist detail, standalone frame ok.

components.name: 线性振动马达
components.desc: 采用长条横向线性马达（非转子），提供清脆精准的「哒哒」触感反馈，是 2018 年旗舰质感中常被忽视的亮点。其长条造型机械感强，单独裱框极具工业美学；拆机报告亦明确点名其为线性马达。
components.descEn: A linear (not rotor) motor gives crisp, precise haptics—an often-overlooked 2018 flagship quality highlight. Its elongated form is mechanically striking alone; teardown confirms the linear type.
components.note: 装裱价值：长条造型机械感强，单独裱框极具工业美学；拆解报告明确点名其为线性马达。
components.noteEn: Framing: elongated form is mechanically striking; teardown confirms linear type.

components.name: 散热石墨膜
components.desc: 后盖内侧覆有大面石墨散热膜，将 SoC 与电池热量均匀导出至后盖。由于玻璃后盖导热受限，需借助石墨膜等大量被动手段散热，其独特纹路肌理可单独平裱呈现「看不见的散热工程」。
components.descEn: A large graphite film inside the back cover spreads SoC and battery heat to the glass back. Glass limits conduction, so passive films do heavy lifting; its texture makes a standalone "invisible thermal engineering" flat frame.
components.note: 装裱价值：石墨膜纹路肌理独特，可单独平裱呈现「看不见的散热工程」。
components.noteEn: Framing: unique graphite texture, great standalone flat frame.

components.name: 散热铜片
components.desc: 主板表面黄色散热铜片覆盖骁龙 845 与内存区，与石墨膜共同构成被动散热路径，是整机视觉焦点之一。其金黄色泽在微距拍摄下极出片，是主板图鉴的主视觉元素。
components.descEn: The golden copper sheet on the mainboard covers the SD845 and RAM, forming a passive path with graphite—a visual focal point. Its golden tone shines in macro shots, the hero element of mainboard frames.
components.note: 装裱价值：铜片金黄色泽是主板图鉴的视觉焦点，微距拍摄极出片。
components.noteEn: Framing: golden copper is the focal point of mainboard macro shots.

components.name: 主板屏蔽罩
components.desc: 主板上的金属屏蔽罩兼具电磁屏蔽、辅助散热与结构支撑三重作用，NFC 线圈亦整合于盖板，副摄铜片固定于其上。拆副摄须破坏铜片与屏蔽罩结构，故装裱以原状展示为宜。
components.descEn: The metal shield cans provide EMI shielding, thermal help and structural support; the NFC coil sits on the cover and the tele cam is copper-fixed to it. Removing the tele cam damages the cans—display in original state.
components.note: 拆解警告：拆副摄须破坏铜片与屏蔽罩结构，装裱以原状展示为宜。
components.noteEn: ⚠ Removing tele cam damages cans; display in original state.

usageNotes: 本资料为「零件功能图鉴级」，适用于装裱设计台的「产品资料库」导入。建议装裱路线：①以主板（带散热铜片）为主视觉大框；②双摄模组（蓝圈IMX363 + 长焦）单独裱框突出影像卖点；③线性马达、BM3E电池标签、Type-C接口做微距工业风小框组合；④刘海元件（红外相机/补光/听筒/距离传感）成组讲「全黑人脸解锁」故事。全机共10大类、40个部件，均含中英双语与装裱/拆解提示。⚠ 本轮未提供实际拆解照片，内部零件（螺丝数、具体PMIC/NFC/IMU型号、屏蔽罩布局）依据公开拆机报告与厂商资料标注，凡无法100%确认的已注明「未验证」，导入后请按实物复核丝印。

framingNotes.recommendedFrame: 极简黑/白铝框或细黑线悬浮框（呼应Nothing风）
framingNotes.frameSize: 主板大框建议 A3；零件微距组合 A4；刘海元件组 A4
framingNotes.notes: OLED屏长期点亮有烧屏风险，展示样机建议循环内容或熄屏；锂电仅展示标签面严禁破坏；玻璃后盖易碎，分离需热风枪。

dataSources.用途: 尺寸/重量/系统/芯片/摄像头型号(S5K3T1/S5K3M3)交叉验证

dataSources.用途: 三段式布局、20颗十字螺丝、线性马达、BM3E电池(飞毛腿/3.85V/13.0Wh)、NFC在盖板、铜片散热等内部结构与零件识别；属非官方，已注明不确定性

dataSources.用途: 拍照105分/视频88分、变焦与散景评价
